title: Architecture decision records (ADRs): context, options and consequences

videos.script: In two years, somebody will look at Carcará's seat holds and ask why they live in Redis. {{title}} The people who decided will have moved on. The meeting notes will be in a chat nobody can search. And the obvious improvement will be the one that was tried, and failed, in 2025. {{forgotten}} A decision record is one page that answers that question before it is asked. {{record}} This lesson is about writing one well. The context, which is the forces and not the solution in disguise. {{context}} The options you did not choose, and why. {{options}} The consequences, including the bad ones. {{consequences}} And what happens when the decision changes. You do not edit the old record. You write a new one that supersedes it, and the history stays readable. {{supersede}}
